decision.explanation: The question asks for the director of the film 'The Charge of the Light Brigade'. The source documents describe three distinct films with this title released in different years: the 1912 film directed by J. Searle Dawley (D1S1), the 1936 film directed by Michael Curtiz (D4S2), and the 1968 film directed by Tony Richardson (D2S2). Since the question does not specify a year, all three directors are valid answers corresponding to different legitimate referents (films) sharing the same title. The candidate 'Steven Spielberg' (C3) appears in D2S1 and D3S2 but is contradicted by the specific attribution to J. Searle Dawley for the 1912 film in D1S1 and D7S1, and is likely an error in the source text or a hallucination in the provided data, thus it is excluded.
